items.name: Mauritius Open 2018

venue.name: African Leadership College
venue.address: West Building, Beau Plan Business Park Pamplemousses

items.information: This will be the first competition in Mauritius, feel free to contact the organization team if you have any question regarding the event. There is no registration fee for this competition.

items.name: Shaastra Cube Open 2018

venue.name: Community Hall, Indian institute of Technology, Madras

items.information: Please read the instructions on the Payment Tab thoroughly before registering. All competitors must be aware of the WCA regulations. There **won't** be any "On the Spot" Registrations available at the Venue on the competition days. Check the schedule tab for the competition Schedule. For more information, go to [shaastra.org](http://shaastra.org/#/events/5a07f5fa9a93510aae63c256)

items.name: South East Texas Open 2018

venue.name: First Baptist Church Port Neches
venue.address: 1900 Magnolia Ave. Port Neches, TX 77651, USA
venue.details: The competition will be held in the church gymnasium.

items.information: There will an 80 person competitor limit. The registration fee for the competition will be $20. The venue is located in the same building as last time.

items.name: Swisscubing Mental Breakdown 2018
items.information: La salle exacte sera annoncée à tous les compétiteurs quelques jours avant l'évènement. Un compétiteur qui s'inscrit et ne vient pas à la compétition (sans nous l'annoncer à l'avance) devra payer des frais supplémentaires à sa prochaine compétition en Suisse. ______________________________________________ The room will be announced to all competitors a few days before the competition. A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.
